description: This is a Python source file for generating a General Ledger report in the ERPNext system, including functions for data retrieval, validation, currency handling, and report formatting.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to generate the general ledger report, validating filters, setting currencies, and retrieving report data.

methods.name: update_translations
methods.description: Updates translation strings used in the report.

methods.name: validate_filters
methods.description: Validates the input filters for mandatory fields and logical consistency.

methods.name: validate_party
methods.description: Validates the party type and party values.

methods.name: set_account_currency
methods.description: Determines and sets the account currency based on filters.

methods.name: get_result
methods.description: Retrieves and processes the report data based on filters and account details.

methods.name: get_gl_entries
methods.description: Fetches general ledger entries from the database with applied filters.

methods.name: get_conditions
methods.description: Builds SQL conditions based on filters.

methods.name: get_accounts_with_children
methods.description: Retrieves all child accounts of given accounts.

methods.name: get_data_with_opening_closing
methods.description: Prepares the data with opening and closing balances.

methods.name: get_totals_dict
methods.description: Creates a dictionary for opening, total, and closing balances.

methods.name: group_by_field
methods.description: Determines the grouping field based on the 'group_by' filter.

methods.name: initialize_gle_map
methods.description: Initializes a mapping of GL entries grouped by the selected grouping.

methods.name: get_accountwise_gle
methods.description: Aggregates GL entries per account or voucher, calculating balances.

methods.name: get_account_type_map
methods.description: Fetches account types for the given company.

methods.name: get_result_as_list
methods.description: Converts raw data into a list format suitable for report display.

methods.name: get_supplier_invoice_details
methods.description: Retrieves supplier invoice numbers linked to GL entries.

methods.name: get_balance
methods.description: Calculates running balance based on debit and credit.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines the columns for the report table, including currency formatting.
